description: rc.8 (F-05): the number rule is closed under the canonical form. A literal whose value is an integer of magnitude greater than 2^53 and less than 10^21 is invalid however it is written (here 1e20): RFC 8785 writes the value 10^20 as the integer literal 100000000000000000000, which the same rule refuses, so a valid document could otherwise have an invalid canonical form.

errors: /x-n: integer value 1e20 is outside ±2^53 and below 10^21 (not representable in canonical form)
